repos_data.description: Open-source IDS/IPS, WAF and bot detection for Linux, Windows, Docker and Kubernetes, with a crowdsourced blocklist of malicious IPs.
📊 The best API for Web Automation, Testing, and Scraping. CDP Mode launches a stealth browser that bypasses bot-detection/CAPTCHAs. Adds stealth to Playwright. Includes an MCP server for AI agents.
The Universal Device Detection library will parse any User Agent and detect the browser, operating system, device used (desktop, tablet, mobile, tv, cars, console, etc.), brand and model.
tirreno is an open-source framework for in-house security. Event tracking, risk scoring and threat detection for your system.

Self-hosted, invisible CAPTCHA that detects AI agents driving real browsers. GDPR, WCAG 2.2 AA, and EAA: no cookies, no third-party data sharing, and no visual or audio puzzle. With a false-positive budget enforced in CI. Proof of work, drop-in for Turnstile and reCAPTCHA.
Official Python, TypeScript, and MCP-server clients for the SentiSift API.
